suspected_issue: Path traversal in GeoIP missing-db download flow
evidence_disproving: GeoIP2AutoUpdater::getConfiguredUrl($key) throws on invalid key and only accepts keys in internal urlOptions map; filename for non-DBIP URLs is derived from fixed dbNames by key; controller also requires superuser and checkTokenInUrl for POST requests.
revisit_conditions: Revisit if urlOptions/dbNames mapping becomes user-controlled or getConfiguredUrl validation changes.
